claim_ceiling: No signal ablation variant beats 64-dim center_projected on both adversarial gates. The 768-dim version fails jurist pairwise (0.491); the 64-dim version (v3) passes both (lang_dom=0.766, pairwise=0.512). citation_weights passes both gates but is degenerate (single cluster, Jurivoc NMI=0.0). All 3 legal embeddings fail language dominance (>0.85) despite Jurivoc L2 NMI up to 0.502. All 6 citation roles are degenerate (identical embeddings). Scale stability perfect (mean cosine=1.0) for non-degenerate variants with frozen PCA. Frontier metric_learning_jurivoc validation blocked upstream (no team dispatched). Boilerplate resistance skipped (requires corpus text).
evidence_summary: 17 variants tested on expanded 1,200-decision slice with frozen global seed=42. Two adversarial gates pre-declared: language dominance < 0.85, jurist pairwise > 0.5. Zero non-degenerate variants pass both gates. 64-dim center_projected (v3) validated baseline passes both. 768-dim center_projected (v6) fails pairwise by 0.009 — protocol deviation (baseline swapped without declaration). citation_weights false positive pass (degenerate). Legal embeddings all fail language dominance. Citation roles all degenerate. Scale stability perfect with frozen PCA. Frontier blocked. Reproducibility confirmed via deterministic re-run.
